contract.description: Search memory before you assume. Call it at session start (project and global scope) to load standing context, before redoing work that may already have a decision on record, and whenever prior context would change the answer: "did we settle X", "what did the human say about Y", "why is this built this way". Returns ranked matches - id, content, scope, kind, tags, similarity and score - over active records only: superseded and tombstoned never surface. Reading a match bumps its access stats so live knowledge stays fresh. Narrow with scope, projectId or tags instead of raising the limit, and pass tome to read another tome you own; memory_scry answers across tomes instead. upstream_unavailable means the embedding provider or store is unreachable; the call is read-only and writes nothing.
contract.name: memory_recall
contract.title: Recall memories
